FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Iran Deal Drives Risk‑On, Yields Rise, Price Above MA20
tldr_points: Iran deal reduces geopolitical risk, sparking risk‑on flows that favor USD over JPY.
US 30‑year yield at 5.02% and rising mortgage rates reinforce dollar strength.
Price holds above the 20‑day MA at 159.44, indicating short‑term bullish bias.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY set to rise on Iran deal‑driven risk‑on sentiment, higher US yields, and price staying above MA20.
FX.comment: USD/JPY bullish on risk‑on sentiment and supportive US yields.
